challenge.intro: Over 12 weeks the challenge shows whether your child is ready for a real dog. One purchase covers one dog.

includes.breed: A paid breed of your choice
includes.certificate: A certificate when the challenge is completed

challenge.priceEstimate: The store shows the final price before you pay.
challenge.pausesAt: Without a purchase the game pauses {{when}}.
challenge.notBought: The challenge has not been bought yet.
challenge.unborn: Not born yet. Buy the challenge now and the dog starts as soon as the contract is signed.
challenge.paused: The game is paused. The dog is safe and progress is kept.
challenge.priceLoading: Loading the price from the store …
challenge.credits_one: You have {{count}} purchased challenge that hasn't been used yet.
challenge.credits_other: You have {{count}} purchased challenges that haven't been used yet.
challenge.storeNote: Payment is handled by the store (App Store or Google Play) with your store account.
challenge.allPaid: No dog is waiting for a purchase. All challenges are unlocked.
challenge.offline: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
challenge.offeringMissing: The challenge can't be loaded from the store right now. Please try again later.

result.unlocked: Thank you! The challenge is unlocked and the game continues.
result.restoredUnlocked: Your purchases have been restored and the challenge is unlocked.
